caption: The drawing features the lower portion of a decorative object that consists of a wide, rounded base, a tapering central section, and part of a structure at the top. The entire design is rendered in fine black ink lines on a light, off-white or beige background. The base is adorned with repeating floral and scrollwork patterns, including flowers and leaves. Above the base, the central section is trapezoidal and densely decorated with complex floral motifs, leaves, and scrolls, along with various patterns filling the space. Near the middle of this section, an oval-shaped frame contains vertically written text. The central section also has a border with hanging leaf-shaped elements and other horizontal decorative bands near the top and bottom. At the very top, only a small portion of what appears to be another ornamented element is visible, containing subtle flower-like motifs. To the right of the drawing, the words "Detail of Design" are written in black, and at the lower right corner, the name "Samuel J. Klein" appears. The artwork has no indication of color aside from the natural color of the medium.
title: Fireman's Trumpet
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
